A CAREFUL FIRST CONNECTION

Your privacy.
A thoughtful first step.

How this website handles your choices and how to contact the practice securely.

Website interactions

The care explorer and inquiry planner work in your browser. Selected choices remain in page memory and are cleared when the page is reloaded. Copying an inquiry outline places its text on your device’s clipboard.

The website does not submit the outline to the practice. Email links open your email application; sending an email is a separate action under your control.

Appointment enquiries

The appointment enquiry tool uses only your selected appointment type and payment preference. It prepares a general message in your browser and does not submit information to the practice.

The email link opens your email application. You decide whether to send the message. This website does not collect medical information, select or upload files, process payment, or reserve appointment times.

The site does not use analytics, advertising trackers, or browser storage for these interaction choices.

Hosting & access

Hosting and sign-in services may process technical information needed to serve the website and manage access under their own policies.

Medical records & patient intake

Request the practice’s approved secure intake or referral route before sharing medical information or insurance documents. General website enquiries and ordinary email are not the patient intake route.

This page describes how the website works. Request the practice’s patient privacy notice from the team for information about clinical records and patient privacy procedures.

Request secure records instructions

Questions & emergencies

For general website privacy questions, contact info@mindwellflorida.com. Do not include patient information in the initial email.

For emergencies, call 911. This website does not provide urgent or emergency care.
